# Gaps (auto-generated by scripts/build_dataset.py)

Every item below is a field left `null` (or derived and flagged in `provenance`) because no allowed source states it.

## Simulator coverage (Xcode 27.1, iOS 27.0 / 27.1 runtimes, measured 2026-10-27)

- `safe_area_insets_pt`: portrait measured for 56 devices, landscape for 33 (iPhones only: iPadOS 27 refused programmatic rotation in its default windowing mode). Key-window safeAreaInsets from scripts/simulator/Measure.swift. Apple does not publish safe areas; devices without a supported Simulator device type stay null and are listed below.
- `corner_radius_pt`: 103 devices, all UNOFFICIAL (private UIScreen `_displayCornerRadius` on booted devices, otherwise the `DeviceCornerRadius` key in the device type's capabilities.plist, which matched the runtime value within 0.34 pt on every booted type). Apple does not publish it.
- Booted on the iOS 27.x runtimes: 57 dataset devices. Static device-type data only: 59. Raw data: sources/simulator/.
- No Simulator device type exists for: iPhone 5/5c/5s and older, iPod touch 1st-6th gen, iPad mini (A20 Pro), Apple Watch Series 1 and 1st gen, Apple Vision Pro (M5) (only the original Vision Pro type exists), any Mac.
- 60 Hz refresh for non-ProMotion devices: Apple spec pages do not state a refresh rate, so `refresh_rate_max_hz` is null unless ProMotion is listed.
